{{Quote|I'm going to get this thing up in the air...even if that means me throwing it.|Nils Cridmeen, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:SP" />}}
'''Nils Cridmeen''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Do you actually have the spare parts we need? Well, I guess we all owe you our lives.|Nils Cridmeen, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:SP" />}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Nils Cridmeen was present on the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] when an [[Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir|accident]] took place in the [[Imperial Research and Prison Facility]].<ref name="SWG:SP" /> The [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]] that was studied there escaped containment and decimated most of the people in the area, turning them into starving [[Zombie/Legends|undead]] creatures. In response, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] promptly established a [[Quarantine Zone (Dathomir)|Quarantine Zone]] to contain the infection.<ref name="SWG:MMR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Mysterious Meeting Request|Dathomir}}</ref> The few people who survived the initial virus outbreak, including Nils Cridmeen,<ref name="SWG:SP" /> were trapped in the Quarantine Zone. The survivors established camps in order to to repel the regular assaults of the zombies and try to live in safety while waiting for an evacuation.<ref name="SWG:MMR" />

[[File:Camp_Epsilon.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Camp Epsilon]] in the [[Quarantine Zone (Dathomir)|Quarantine Zone]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].]]
Nils Cridmeen took shelter in [[Camp Epsilon]], the most unsafe camp since it was located in the courtyard of the Imperial Research and Prison Facility, the place where lived the most dangerous undeads.<ref name="SWG:SP" /> Other survivors in the camp at that time included the former prisoner [[Zsu Val]]<ref name="SWG:FWEC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Forward Watch, Epsilon Camp|Dathomir}}</ref>, the technician [[Sogan Varga]],<ref name="SWG:DR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Deliver Radio|Dathomir}}</ref> the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Klex Fulgor]],<ref name="SWG:AA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Administrative Access|Dathomir}}</ref> and the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] [[GT-643]], [[KD-121]] and [[HX-138]].<ref name="SWG:FtS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Find the Stormtroopers|Dathomir}}</ref> Nils Cridmeen and HX-138 expected to be able to fix a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttle]] present in the camp in order to allow the survivors to escape the Quarantine Zone.<ref name="SWG:SP" />

At some point, a group of spacers visited Camp Epsilon during their journey in the Quarantine Zone. They intended to help HX-138 in order to get the support of HX-138 and her stormtroopers to access the research facility. HX-138 thus tasked the spacers to find parts to repair the damaged ''Lambda'' shuttle: power converters, a computer core memory, a spinal trunk and fuel cells. The spacers explored the Quarantine Zone and collected the needed parts on the wreckage of crashed shuttles and brought them to Nils Cridmeen.<ref name="SWG:SP" /> The mechanic started the repairs while the spacers entered the research facility. The spacers survived to their mission and finally came back to Camp Epsilon. In the meantime, Nils Cridmeen was able to fix the Lambda-class shuttle. The refugees of Camp Epsilon and the spacers eventually escaped the Quarantine Zone altogether with the repaired shuttle.<ref name="SWG:E">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Escape|Dathomir}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Nils Cridmeen was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:SP" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Nils Cridmeen was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 14|Game Update 14]]," a.k.a. the [[W:c:swg:Death Troopers|"Death Troopers" update]], released on [[October 12]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 14: Death Troopers">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1008376|text=Game Update 14: Death Troopers}}</ref>
